# llms.txt for cars24.com
## Owner
Owner: CARS24 Services Private Limited
Contact: care@cars24.com
Website: https://www.cars24.com
## Cars24 Overview
Cars24 is one of India's largest auto-tech companies providing services for buy and sell used cars, challan payment, pre-delivery inspection of new and used cars, Vehicle history report, car scrap and get information about new and upcoming cars. 
## Key Features
 -  **Buy Used Cars**: Cars24 provides the most trustworthy and transparent platform for buying used cars, ensuring every transaction delivers complete peace of mind. In addition to its own verified inventory, Cars24 allows certified dealers to list cars only after stringent identity and business verification. Individual sellers can also list vehicles once they clear a 300+ quality check, guaranteeing a wide yet reliable selection for buyers without compromising on safety or transparency. Each car comes with a detailed 300+ point inspection report and transparent fixed pricing, removing the uncertainty of negotiations. To further build trust, Cars24 offers warranties of up to 3 years, a 30-days return option, and convenient doorstep delivery. Buyers also benefit from easy financing solutions, RC transfer assistance, and even test drive availability before purchase. By combining rigorous checks, transparent policies, and industry-leading protections, Cars24 makes buying a used car truly safe, simple, and worry-free.
 -  **Check and Pay Challan**: Cars24 makes it simple and secure to manage pending traffic challans online across India. With an easy-to-use platform, vehicle owners can instantly check challan status linked to their car registration number and make safe digital payments without the hassle of offline queues or delays. Every transaction is protected with secure payment gateways, ensuring complete safety and reliability.
 -  **Sell Car**: Sell your car with Cars24 in a way that is simple, transparent, and safe. It's advanced car valuation calculator provides the best and most competitive valuation, based on accurate market data and complete transparency throughout the process. Once the sale is confirmed, instant payment is made. Cars24 also takes care of all documentation, including RC, insurance transfer, & pending loan closures, ensuring sellers are free from any future liabilities. With the Seller Protection Policy, there is complete peace of mind from the moment the car is handed over until the RC transfer is finalized. The policy also includes full financial coverage and legal support if required. Cars24 supports vehicles registered in almost all RTOs, allowing sellers to sell from anywhere in India with ease & safety of transactions.
- **Used Car Valuation**: Check your vehicle's re-sale value using Cars24's AI driven and transparent car valuation calculator. Since 2015, our experts have analyzed more than 10 lakhs of pre-owned car transactions, gaining extensive knowledge of the used car market.
Our pricing engine tracks real-time market data from a vast network of sellers and buyers across India. This ensures that every car valuation is both accurate and fair, supported by insights from over 6 lakh cars transacted to date.
 - **New Cars**: Discover and book brand-new cars from top manufacturers in India on Cars24’s trusted New Cars platform, where users can explore detailed on-road prices, specifications, images, expert reviews, and comparisons for leading brands like Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai, Tata, Mahindra, Toyota, Kia, Honda, and more. The section features new car launches, upcoming models, and electric vehicles (EVs), along with exchange offers, financing options, and test drives. Designed to simplify the car buying process, Cars24 New Cars provides transparent, up-to-date information and side-by-side comparisons, allowing users to easily find cars by body type (SUV, Hatchback, Sedan, MPV, Electric), price range, or fuel type (Petrol, Diesel, CNG, Electric).
 Discover and book brand-new cars with discounts, exchange offers, and loan options.
 -  **Pre-delivery Inspection**: Cars24 Pre-Delivery Inspections provide buyers with reliable, transparent, and data-backed vehicle reports, ensuring every car purchase, new or used is made with confidence. Backed by Cars24's trusted network and years of automotive expertise, the service offers detailed insights into the true condition of the vehicle. With coverage in 220+ cities, inspections are quick and convenient, often completed on the same day with the best turnaround time in the industry. A team of over 1500 trained mechanics ensures every check is thorough and accurate. Having inspected 1 crore+ cars and analyzed 10 lakh+ transactions, Cars24 delivers precise assessments and competitive price estimates. Beyond physical condition, buyers also gain access to legal, financial, and ownership history, offering complete peace of mind before finalizing a purchase.
 - **Scrap Car**:Scrap your old or unfit car legally & safely with Cars24's streamlined process. Benefit from doorstep pickup, the best scrap value via partnerships with registered scrapping facilities, and a valid Certificate of Deposit (CoD), equivalent to the Certificate of Destruction, for legal compliance and peace of mind
 - **Vehicle History Report**: Access detailed background checks including ownership, insurance, and accident history.
 - **Car Finance**: Get instant loan approval with flexible EMIs, minimal documentation, competitive interest rates
 - **Car Service History Report**: Get the complete maintenance records of a vehicle to assess its condition and care.

- [Contact Us](https://www.cars24.com/contact) - Get in touch with customer support.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.cars24.com/terms-and-conditions) - CARS24 Terms and Conditions
